default.notes: A visitor's visa must be obtained from a Kittitian mission or honorary consulate before travelling — there is no visa on arrival and no eVisa.

groups.notes: CARICOM nationals enter under Caribbean Community free-movement arrangements — a definite entry of up to six months is granted on arrival.
Visa-free for tourism for up to 90 days; show a return or onward ticket and your accommodation address on arrival.
Visa-free for tourism for up to 90 days under the Federation's waiver for Latin American passports.
Commonwealth citizens are admitted visa-free for up to 90 days; the officer sets the exact period on the entry stamp.
Visa-free for up to 90 days under a bilateral waiver — confirm the current allowance with a Kittitian mission before a long stay.
Taiwan (ROC) passport holders enter visa-free for up to 90 days — the Federation is one of Taipei's diplomatic partners.
Commonwealth membership does not carry a visa waiver for this nationality — apply for a visitor's visa at a Kittitian mission before travelling.

KN.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for citizens of Saint Kitts and Nevis.

CN.notes: The Federation maintains diplomatic relations with Taiwan rather than Beijing — holders of PRC passports need a visa arranged in advance.
